findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.masqot.co" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_event, get_community, search_blog_posts, get_blog_post, search_posts, get_post, get_my_profile, list_my_posts, get_my_post_stats, list_post_comments, get_my_notification_counts · Private data: search_posts, search_marketplace_products · Public sink: get_blog_post, get_post, get_my_profile, get_my_post_stats, list_post_comments · Destructive: search_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_event, get_community, search_blog_posts, get_blog_post, search_posts, get_post, get_my_profile, list_my_posts, get_my_post_stats, list_post_comments, get_my_notification_counts · Private data: search_posts, search_marketplace_products · Public sink: get_blog_post, get_post, get_my_profile, get_my_post_stats, list_post_comments · Destructive: search_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
